cycle.irregular: Your cycle length varied by {days} days, more than the regular range (≤{limit} days).
cycle.frequent: Your median cycle is {days} days, shorter than the normal range ({min}–{max}).
cycle.infrequent: Your median cycle is {days} days, longer than the normal range ({min}–{max}).

period.prolonged: Your median period is {days} days; talk to a doctor about periods longer than {max} days.

pattern.before_period: {symptom} came back in {cycles} of {total} cycles, {days} days before your period.
pattern.early: {symptom} came back in {cycles} of {total} cycles, in the first {days} days of the cycle.
pattern.mid: {symptom} came back in {cycles} of {total} cycles, around cycle days {start}–{end}.
pattern.mid_day: {symptom} came back in {cycles} of {total} cycles, around cycle day {start}.

findings.not_enough_data: Log {needed} more cycles to see your patterns.
findings.no_data: Nothing to analyse yet. Start with a daily log.

sleep_mood.more: After nights under 6 hours of sleep, “frustrated” or “irritable” was logged {ratio}× as often ({hits} of {days} days).
sleep_mood.only: “Frustrated” or “irritable” was only logged after nights under 6 hours of sleep ({hits} of {days} days).
sleep_mood.less: After nights under 6 hours of sleep, “frustrated” or “irritable” was logged less often.

phase_energy.more: “High” energy was logged {ratio}× as often in the {high_phase} phase as in the {low_phase} phase.
phase_energy.only: “High” energy was logged mostly in the {high_phase} phase.

exercise_cramps.less: On period days with exercise, severe cramps were logged less often.
exercise_cramps.more: On period days with exercise, severe cramps were logged more often.

phase_mood.best: Good moods were logged most in the {phase} phase ({pct}% of days).

correlations.not_causal: These are things that happen together in your own data, not cause and effect.

suggestion.log_sleep: Log your sleep every day to see how it relates to your mood and symptoms.
suggestion.sleep_symptom_needs_cycles: Keep logging your sleep; {needed} more cycles are needed to see how sleep and {symptom} relate.
suggestion.more_cycles: Keep logging daily; {needed} more cycles are needed to see your patterns.
suggestion.log_more: Log more days to make next month’s report more accurate.
suggestion.keep_going: Keep logging regularly; you have enough data for next month’s report.
